methods.description: Mobile metrics aggregate iOS App Store and Google Play data worldwide; for China, only iOS is counted.
All 2025 values are projections through the remainder of the calendar year, while 2026 values are Sensor Tower forecasts.
App and game categories are assigned using Sensor Tower’s App IQ and Game IQ taxonomies as of December 2025.
Digital-advertising spend charts reflect spend in the United States across a specified set of digital ad channels (social, mobile, desktop, OTT, etc.).
Website-traffic analysis covers the top 1,000 US sites ranked by total visits between October 2024 and October 2025.
Steam release counts treat 2025 figures as year-to-date through 4 December 2025.
